metadata.description: Extended domain ontology and OI-XXX issue registry for the orthogonal-engineering monorepo. Extends pr26_ontological_issues.json with new domains and cross-domain issues identified via the DeepSeek methodology.

domains.name: Graphics & Shaders
invariants: Shader compilation output is deterministic given identical source and compiler version.
Rendering backend equivalence: the same scene produces pixel-identical output across Vulkan/Metal/D3D/OpenGL given identical inputs.

domains.name: Cryptography
invariants: All secret-dependent operations are constant-time.
Protocol validity rules (e.g., PSK ≠ 0^32) are enforced at the API boundary.
No secret material is stored in plain-text logs or error messages.

domains.name: Aviation & ATC
invariants: All external API calls have a defined timeout and fallback.
Stale data is flagged to the pilot; no silent data propagation.
Safety-critical computations complete within the certified time budget.

domains.name: Web Security
invariants: All user-controlled input is sanitized before reaching an HTML, SQL, or shell sink.
Authentication tokens are bound to session and not replayable.
CSRF tokens are required for all state-mutating requests.

domains.name: Space Systems
invariants: Runtime memory protections (canaries, ASLR) are present in all safety-critical binaries.
Static analysis is a complement to, not a replacement for, runtime enforcement.
No unbounded recursion or dynamic allocation in hard real-time paths.

domains.name: Video Game Mods
invariants: Only one ASI loader occupies the loader interception slot at runtime.
Mod version identity is deterministically verifiable against the game executable hash.
Conflicting mods are detected and reported before launch.

domains.name: Medical Systems
invariants: Dosimetry calculations agree with the reference algorithm within certified tolerance.
All safety-critical actions are logged with an immutable audit trail.
Software failures default to a safe state (fail-safe design).

domains.name: Industrial / OT
invariants: PLC cycle-time is within the specified real-time deadline.
OT/IT network boundaries are enforced; no direct internet access from PLC.
Firmware updates are authenticated and integrity-checked before installation.

domains.name: Blue-Collar / Trades
invariants: Worker safety alerts are delivered within the required response time.
Field-service records are immutably logged and tamper-evident.
Offline-capable: critical functions work without network connectivity.

domains.name: White-Collar / Knowledge Work
invariants: Document processing pipelines are idempotent.
Audit trails are append-only and cryptographically signed.
Financial calculations use arbitrary-precision arithmetic, not floating-point.

domains.name: Luxury / High-End
invariants: HFT order-book state is deterministic: same inputs produce same outputs.
Premium UX renders pixel-identically across device tiers.
Private aviation software meets the same safety invariants as commercial aviation.

domains.name: Emergency Response
invariants: Dispatch systems handle network partitions without data loss.
Mass-notification delivery is confirmed end-to-end within SLO.
Emergency systems operate in degraded mode when dependencies are unavailable.

domains.name: Necessity / Infrastructure
invariants: All control-system software meets IEC 61508 SIL requirements.
No single point of failure in critical control paths.
Security patches are applied within the certified maintenance window.

domains.name: Boring / Commodity
invariants: ETL pipelines are idempotent: re-running produces the same output.
Report generation is deterministic given identical inputs.
Data-format conversions preserve all semantic content.

domains.name: Fun / Entertainment
invariants: Deterministic game seeds produce identical game states.
Saved game data is forward-compatible with new versions.
Online matchmaking produces fair and deterministic results.

domains.name: Creative / Generative
invariants: Given a fixed seed, generative output is reproducible.
Style transfer preserves specified content invariants.
Generated audio is not perceptually identical to copyrighted material.

domains.name: Non-Creative / Deterministic
invariants: Compression/decompression is lossless and reproducible.
Batch processing output is identical for identical inputs.
Format conversion round-trips without data loss.

issues.title: Non-deterministic shader compilation due to hash-map iteration order
issues.description: Shader compilers that use unordered hash-maps for reflection data produce different SPIR-V bytecode across runs when iteration order changes (e.g., after ASLR, different allocator state).
assumptions_violated: Shader compilation output is deterministic given identical source.
issues.resolution_notes: Replace hash-map iteration with sorted iteration in all pipeline stages that produce hashed output. TODO: wire into CI via F-GRAPHICS-001.

issues.title: Lock-free atomics assume sequentially-consistent hardware
issues.description: Code that uses lock-free atomics without explicit memory-ordering annotations will produce data races on ARMv7 and other weak-memory architectures.
assumptions_violated: lock-free atomics provide sequentially-consistent ordering on all architectures.
issues.resolution_notes: Annotate all atomic operations with explicit Acquire/Release or SeqCst semantics. TODO: add TSAN job to CI.

issues.title: External weather API assumed always available
issues.description: Aviation software that fetches live METAR data without circuit-breakers or cached fallbacks will freeze or display stale data silently during API outages.
assumptions_violated: External weather API is always available.
API latency is bounded by a safe timeout.
issues.resolution_notes: Implement circuit-breaker with cached fallback. TODO: add F-API-001 to CI network-tests job.

issues.title: PQC polynomial arithmetic has timing side-channels
issues.description: Variable-time polynomial arithmetic in PQC implementations (Falcon, Kyber) leaks timing information correlated with secret key bits.
assumptions_violated: Pure C arithmetic is constant-time on all compilers and hardware.
issues.resolution_notes: Use formally verified constant-time libraries. TODO: add dudect CI job.

issues.title: Noise PSK zero-key accepted without validation
issues.description: Library accepts a 32-byte all-zero PSK, violating the Noise Protocol Framework invariant PSK ≠ 0^32.
assumptions_violated: Callers supply a non-zero PSK; no server-side validation needed.
issues.resolution_notes: Add PSK validation at API boundary. TODO: implement F-CRYPTO-002 test.

issues.title: cFS security depends solely on static analysis
issues.description: NASA cFS security relies on static analysis without runtime enforcement (ASLR, stack canaries). Vulnerabilities evading static analysis are undetected until flight.
assumptions_violated: Static analysis catches all exploitable defects.
issues.resolution_notes: Add -fstack-protector-strong to all safety-critical compilation units. TODO: implement F-SPACE-001 binary check.

issues.title: User-supplied Markdown reaches HTML sink unsanitized
issues.description: Stored XSS via unsanitized Markdown rendering in GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES).
assumptions_violated: Markdown rendering sanitizes all HTML before output.
issues.resolution_notes: Pass all rendered output through DOMPurify or equivalent. TODO: implement F-XSS-001 test.

issues.title: Dual ASI loader conflict not detected at launch
issues.description: Game mod systems may silently allow two ASI loaders to coexist, causing unpredictable hook ordering and crashes.
assumptions_violated: Only one ASI loader can occupy the loader space.
issues.resolution_notes: Add pre-launch loader-slot scan. TODO: implement F-GAMEMODS-001.

issues.title: Dosimetry software not validated against reference algorithm
issues.description: Medical dosimetry software that lacks a falsification test against the IEC 62304 reference algorithm may silently diverge from the certified calculation.
assumptions_violated: The software dosimetry calculation agrees with the reference algorithm within ±0.1%.
issues.resolution_notes: TODO: implement F-MEDICAL-001 with canonical patient-phantom dataset.

issues.title: PLC cycle-time not continuously verified
issues.description: PLC control loops without cycle-time monitoring may silently miss real-time deadlines under load.
assumptions_violated: The PLC control loop completes each cycle within the specified real-time deadline.
issues.resolution_notes: TODO: implement F-INDUSTRIAL-001 with high-resolution cycle timer.

issues.title: Worker safety alerts not tested for delivery latency
issues.description: Safety alert systems that lack end-to-end delivery latency tests may silently fail to meet the required response time under load.
assumptions_violated: Worker safety alerts are delivered within the required response time.
issues.resolution_notes: TODO: implement F-BLUECOLLAR-001 with end-to-end latency measurement.

issues.title: Document pipeline not verified as idempotent
issues.description: Document processing pipelines that are not tested for idempotency may produce different outputs on re-runs, breaking audit trails.
assumptions_violated: Document processing pipelines are idempotent.
issues.resolution_notes: TODO: implement F-WHITECOLLAR-001 with dual-run comparison.

issues.title: HFT order-book state not verified as deterministic
issues.description: High-frequency trading systems that do not verify order-book determinism may produce inconsistent fills under identical market conditions.
assumptions_violated: HFT order-book state is deterministic: same inputs produce same outputs.
issues.resolution_notes: TODO: implement F-LUXURY-001 with replay test harness.

issues.title: Dispatch system not tested for partition tolerance
issues.description: Emergency dispatch systems that are not tested under network-partition conditions may lose data or fail silently during outages.
assumptions_violated: Dispatch systems handle network partitions without data loss.
issues.resolution_notes: TODO: implement F-EMERGENCY-001 with chaos-engineering partition simulation.

issues.title: Critical infrastructure software missing SIL assessment
issues.description: Infrastructure control software deployed without a formal IEC 61508 SIL assessment may not meet the required reliability target.
assumptions_violated: All control-system software meets IEC 61508 SIL requirements.
issues.resolution_notes: TODO: engage certified assessor; add SIL evidence to ontology.

issues.title: ETL pipeline not verified as idempotent
issues.description: ETL pipelines that are not tested for idempotency may produce duplicate records or different aggregates on re-runs.
assumptions_violated: ETL pipelines are idempotent: re-running produces the same output.
issues.resolution_notes: TODO: implement F-BORING-001 with dual-run row-count assertion.

issues.title: Game save data not forward-compatible across versions
issues.description: Game save files that are not tested for forward-compatibility may corrupt or fail to load after an update.
assumptions_violated: Saved game data is forward-compatible with new versions.
issues.resolution_notes: TODO: implement F-FUN-001 with cross-version save/load test.

issues.title: Generative output not reproducible from fixed seed
issues.description: Generative AI pipelines that do not fix the random seed at all layers may produce different outputs for the same prompt/seed combination.
assumptions_violated: Given a fixed seed, generative output is reproducible.
issues.resolution_notes: TODO: implement F-CREATIVE-001 with dual-generation hash comparison.

issues.title: Compression round-trip not verified as lossless
issues.description: Data compression pipelines that are not tested for round-trip losslessness may silently corrupt data.
assumptions_violated: Compression/decompression is lossless and reproducible.
issues.resolution_notes: TODO: implement F-NONCREATIVE-001 with compress→decompress→compare test.
